How to learn any skill
faster than most people
Break the skill into small parts. Guitar is chords, rhythm and songs. Practising one piece at a time makes progress much faster.
Practise a little every day. Twenty minutes daily beats three hours once a week. Your brain learns best through regular repetition.
Get feedback early. A teacher, a friend, a video of yourself. Fixing mistakes early stops bad habits from setting in.
Learn from the best. Watch people who are great at it and copy how they do it. Imitation is how every expert started.
Build the habit of learning itself. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it trained my brain to pick up new things faster.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It trained my brain to pick up new things faster.

slides.texte_overlay: Teach what you learn. Explaining a skill to someone else shows you what you really understand. Teach one friend this week and see how much clearer it becomes.
Accept being bad at first. Every beginner is clumsy. The men who learn fastest are the ones who don't mind looking silly.
